headline: Mexican Steelmaker Simec Reports Q3 Profit Jump
summary: Mexican steelmaker Simec reported a Q3 profit of $92 million, a 3.7x increase, primarily attributed to currency gains rather than operational steel performance.
why: Simec is a publicly traded steel producer. Distinguishing between operational earnings and non-recurring currency gains is essential for fundamental analysis.

impacts.name: Simec
impacts.why: Reported profit increase may influence stock price despite the non-operational nature of the gains.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The headline profit figure often triggers algorithmic or retail buying before investors digest the underlying cause of the earnings jump.
